name: agent-teams
description: DRI-led agent teams: the /dri playbook, four role agents, a global learning workspace and initiative registry. Hard-requires beads (bd).

use_advisors.title: Use advisors
use_advisors.description: When enabled, background DRI sessions run on sonnet with an opus advisor (--model sonnet --advisor opus) instead of the default opus-only.

dri_model.title: DRI model
dri_model.description: The 'strong model' slot: when advisors are enabled, this is the advisor's model (the DRI session worker stays sonnet); when advisors are disabled, this is the DRI session's own model. Default "opus" reproduces today's hardcoded behavior in both cases.
